questions.question: What is the effective date of the HR Policy Manual?
During the first three months of probation, may employees work remotely?
questions.reference_answer: No, employees in the first three months of probation work from the office unless the Department Head approves an exception in writing.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of ad hoc remote days per month without Department Head approval?
Can an employee on a Performance Improvement Plan work remotely?
questions.reference_answer: Employees on a Performance Improvement Plan may be required to work from the office for the duration of the plan, at the discretion of the Department Head and the HRBP.

questions.question: Which employees are ineligible for remote work due to open information security violations?
questions.reference_answer: Employees who have an open information security violation under NXR-IT-001 are not eligible for remote work until the matter has been closed.

questions.question: What daily meal cap applies to an L5 grade employee on Tier 1 cities while on overnight business travel?
Above what expense amount is dual approval required from both Department Head and Finance approver?
When must an employee report a lost or stolen device within one hour, and to whom?
questions.reference_answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to security@nexoratech.example and through NexoraDesk within one hour of discovery.

questions.question: What is the maximum grant duration for R3 production access level?
Can an employee on probation hold R4 production access?
questions.reference_answer: No, an employee on probation may hold R1 access only; R4 access is prohibited.

questions.question: Under what condition may an employee work from abroad for personal reasons?
questions.reference_answer: Employees must not work from outside India without prior written approval; personal work from abroad is governed by Section 8 of the Remote Work Policy.

questions.question: Under what condition may a gift above ₹5,000 be accepted?
questions.reference_answer: A gift above ₹5,000 must be declined or returned; if refusal would cause serious offence, it must be handed to Legal & Compliance which will decide how it is used.

questions.question: May an employee working remotely use a personal laptop to access source code?
questions.reference_answer: No, personal laptops must not be used to access source code, customer data, or Restricted information.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive days of casual leave an employee may take?
When must an employee on probation complete Information Security Awareness training?
Which policy governs the reimbursement of travel expenses for business trips?
questions.reference_answer: The Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy (NXR-FIN-001) governs business travel and expense reimbursement.

questions.question: Can an employee on probation be placed on the primary on-call rotation?
questions.reference_answer: No, employees on probation are not eligible for the primary on-call rotation.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length required by the IT Security Policy?
Which employees are ineligible for remote work due to an open disciplinary process?
questions.reference_answer: Employees who have an open disciplinary process under Section 11 of NXR-HR-001 are not eligible for remote work until the matter has been closed.

questions.question: What daily meal allowance may be claimed for same-day travel of more than 8 hours?
questions.reference_answer: A lunch allowance of up to ₹700 may be claimed with a receipt.

questions.question: Can a contractor work remotely from a location outside India?
questions.reference_answer: The policy does not explicitly state whether contractors may work from outside India. Contractors may work remotely only where permitted by their engagement terms, and the applicable work-from-abroad requirements must be followed.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of consecutive days of privileged leave that may be carried forward to the next year?
